Germany Scrambles Jets Amid Nuremberg Airport Aviation Emergency

Germany's Nuremberg Airport experienced a temporary closure due to an aviation emergency, prompting the scrambling of fighter jets to escort a flight originating from Corfu. The airport has since reopened.
